name: Skeleton
description: A pulsing placeholder in the shape of loading content, hidden from assistive technology; mark the region being loaded with aria-busy.

shape.description: What it stands in for: `text` a line of text, painted where a one-line Text puts its glyphs; `rect` a block as wide as its column and one control tall; `circle` an avatar one control across.

width.description: Width it paints, in pixels or any CSS length, in place of the shape's default; a circle given only a width is as tall.

height.description: Height it paints, in pixels or any CSS length, in place of the shape's default; a circle given only a height is as wide.

aria.role: none — the root sets aria-hidden="true", which a passed aria-hidden cannot change, so no skeleton reaches the accessibility tree
notes: Mark the region being loaded with aria-busy="true" and remove it when the content arrives; announce a long load in a live region of your own.

Without a size each shape takes the box of the content it stands in for: text a one-line Text with its membrane across its column, from Text's own tokens; rect one control tall across its column; circle one control across, like Avatar.
A text line paints a bar where the glyphs will be: inset like them and as tall as the text, with the space of a one-line Text around it; it is never wider than its column.

width and height are the size it paints, below one control as well as above; a width or height in style wins over them. A circle stays round from the one side it is given, a percentage of its column included.
The pulse runs for --uf-motion-duration-skeleton and repeats until the skeleton is replaced; under reduced motion it does not run.
In forced colors the placeholder is painted in GrayText.

whenToUse: A one-line text still loading, such as a name, a title or a label: the default shape lines up with the Text that replaces it (width for a shorter line)
An image, chart, card or paragraph still loading (shape rect with its height; a stack of text lines is taller than a wrapped paragraph)
whenNotToUse: An action the user started (use Button loading)
